description: Audit a whole lockfile for known vulnerabilities and malware in one call: package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, requirements.txt, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Pipfile.lock, Cargo.lock or go.sum, up to 1,000 exact versions checked against OSV.dev, with affected packages, severity and versions to upgrade to. Price: $0.05 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). Paid only (not in the free trial).

content.description: Or: the lockfile text itself (up to 60 KB; use url for bigger files).

filename.description: The file's name when sending content, e.g. poetry.lock (helps detect the format).

format.description: Force the format if detection fails.

name: package-audit-lockfile

found.description: Exact package versions found in the file.

packages.description: Affected packages with vulnerabilities and upgradeTo.

truncated.description: True if the file had more than 1000 packages (the first 1000 were checked).

title: Package audit lockfile ($0.05)
